verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents its own automation feature, Workflows, which automates ML tasks as GPU-backed pipelines defined in a few lines of code. Deployments also run containers as a service, which suggests long-running background execution. The API, CLI and auto-shutdown are building blocks or adjacent controls and earn no credit. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduled or event-triggered runs, detail on unattended background execution and monitoring, in-depth Workflows documentation, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that Workflows run autonomously.
